🇮🇷 Iran's Resistance Front pledges united response to any new US-Israeli attack
Commanders across the regional Resistance Front have pledged "all-out loyalty" to Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei following his order to respond swiftly to threats without "geographical limitations," IRGC Quds Force commander Esmail Qa'ani said Wednesday.
Qa'ani said written messages from resistance officials showed that the order had been received and put into operation across the region, demonstrating unity among allied forces.
Khamenei earlier warned that any renewed US or Israeli aggression would trigger a "much more extensive" response, praising resistance forces in Palestine, Lebanon, Iraq and Yemen.
